name: Separator Cone for Nested Geometric Substitution
statement: For nested shores $S\subseteq B$, write the outer signed separators independent of the replaced coordinate as $h_\ell(x)<0$ and the remaining ones as $a_p(x)+b_pz<0$ with $b_p>0$. If $\alpha_q(y)<0$ are signed separators for the inner test, then the inequalities $h_\ell(x)<0$ and $a_p(x)/b_p+\alpha_q(y)<0$ realize the substituted class $(B\times T)\cup(S\times Q^Y)$.
proof: A word of $B\times T$ uses an outer witness at replaced value zero and a test witness; scaling the test block makes all sums negative. A word of $S\times Q^Y$ uses an outer witness at value one, so every normalized outer term is negative; scaling the outer block dominates any chosen test signs. A forbidden outer word violates an independent separator, while a word in $(B\setminus S)\times T^{\mathrm c}$ makes one normalized outer term and one test separator nonnegative.
